title: Sizing definition
description: How the platform decided how big the position is. Nine modes, each with its own required cast: equivalent to a discriminated union, and it is the exact place where the repo's ONE numeric unit-ambiguity lives in the schema too - the single `value` column (executor.executions.sizing_value) is a USD amount, a raw quantity or a PERCENT depending on the mode, so this contract makes `value` untyped decimal and lets `mode` say how to read it. Percent modes REQUIRE balance_basis: the sizing engine refuses a percent mode without a basis rather than guessing which balance was meant. This mirrors shared/contracts/openapi/fudcourt.yaml SizingDefinition, which is the documented HTTP surface.

balance_basis.description: A percentage sizing mode MUST name the balance basis explicitly - a percent of an unnamed basis is not a size.

sizing_mode.description: The nine sizing modes of SizingDefinition['mode']. Percent-valued modes require balance_basis to be present (the sizing engine refuses a percent mode without a basis).
